Git.NotInstalled: git is not installed. Install it from git-scm.com (or set FM_GIT to its path), then open this again.
Git.ReadOnly: The Git history is read-only: copy the files out to change them.
Git.OpenFromFolder: Open the Git history from a folder of a repository (Plugins > Git history).
Git.GitProgramHelp: Empty: FM_GIT, then git on the PATH and in the usual folders.
Git.RefreshHelp: How long a repository's status is used before git is asked again.
Git.Commits: Commits listed in the Git history
Git.CommitsHelp: The newest commits of the current branch in the commits folder.
Git.DiscardMany: Put {0} items back as in the last commit? Their changes are lost (new files that Git does not know stay).
Git.DiscardOne: Put "{0}" back as in the last commit? Its changes are lost.
Git.MessageAll: Message of the commit (every change of the known files):
Git.NewBranchName: Name of the new branch (made from the current one and switched to):
Git.NoChanges: No changes against the last commit.
Git.NoCommitsYet: This file has no commits yet.
Git.NoOtherBranch: There is no other branch. Git: New branch... makes one.
Git.NothingStaged: Nothing is staged. Commit every change of the files Git knows (new files stay out)?
Git.NothingToCommit: Nothing to commit: the working folder is as in the last commit.
